summary: Confirmed $55 base (+$5 booking fee as reservation_fee), 50A full hookups; added weekly/monthly and extra-adult charge, 50 sites, max 45 ft, pull-throughs, laundry, Wi-Fi, pool, Campspot booking. Over $50 but the Branson gateway (8 km) lifts the gate. Lakeview confirmed from the operator's own campsite photo.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview confirmed: the operator's gallery photo BransonViewRVPark-40.jpg is captioned 'a view from a campsite at Branson View RV Park with trees in the foreground and a clear view of Table Rock Lake in the background', and the frame shows open water across the valley beyond Hwy 265 from ground level; the aerials (-43, -46) show the lake a few km off. Distant view from the park's edge sites, not on-water.
PRICE GATE: $55 a night plus a $5 booking fee (operator page; Campspot $60 one-night) - over $50, but passes on the gateway test (Branson attraction, 8 km). Not a Good Sam Park. Never stayed at.

LONG-STAY (passes): weekly/monthly sold and the page invites 'make your Branson stay a seasonal one', but Campspot sells single nights, 12 sites were free on a November weeknight and 30 on 2027-05-11, and about ten sites are marked '(daily/ weekly ONLY)'. Tests: (1) gateway; (2) booking site selling one night; (3) no minimum; (4) well over 1 in 10 nightly; (5) not a home community.
REVIEWS: Google 4.3 from 271; RV Life 4 stars from 38 - pass.
Campspot lists the park as 'Branson View RV Resort - Branson, MO'; the operator's site and Google say Branson View RV Park (stored name kept).
